actions.action: Check leaf undersides and stem joints for spider mite webbing or speckles
If mites found, rinse plant in shower
If mites found, treat with insecticidal soap weekly
Watch plant over next 24-48 hours for leaves unrolling
If soil wet and plant still sulks after 3-4 days, unpot and check for mushy roots
Check top 2-3 cm of soil by touch and water thoroughly when dry, emptying saucer
Run a humidifier nearby to reach 50%+ humidity
Check whether the white unit (possible humidifier) has been off
Move plant out of direct path of heater or vent
Angle blinds during strong afternoon sun
Trim fully yellow or crispy leaves

reason: The answer names drying out as the main cause and its key advice (soak, then water by touch) matches the confirmed fix, with nothing likely to harm the plant.
